Factor the common term \((2x+3)\):

\[
(2x+3)(x-4)+(2x+3)(x-6)=0
\]

\[
(2x+3)\big((x-4)+(x-6)\big)=0
\]

\[
(2x+3)(2x-10)=0
\]

So the roots are:

\[
2x+3=0 \implies x=-\frac{3}{2}
\]

and

\[
2x-10=0 \implies x=5
\]

Their sum is:

\[
-\frac{3}{2}+5=\frac{7}{2}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{7}{2}\).
